svg.text: COMPLETE CIRCUIT — Arduino Nano ESP32 build
Every connection on the bench right now. 3.3 V logic throughout; the only 6 V nets are the coil and the Nano's VIN.
wire these next — the green button
is the ONLY thing that wakes the board
low-side IRLZ44N · coil on the 6 V rail
add 1000 µF across +6 V / GND (long leg = +)
A0 reads the cell, not the 6 V rail
Every GND is the same rail.
MT3608 OUT−, Nano GND, RC522 GND, both buttons, both LEDs, buzzer (−), MOSFET source, 100 kΩ, divider bottom.
Nano VIN and the coil / diode-band end. Nothing else — the RC522, LEDs and gate all live at 3.3 V.
SS D10 · SCK D13 · MOSI D11 · MISO D12 · RST D4 · 3.3V ← 3V3 · GND. IRQ left empty.
Green = wake + scan. Red tap = cancel, red hold 5 s = admin. Both held at reset = factory wipe.
